title.narrative: UNICEF advanced decentralized, inclusive local governance by strengthening participatory approaches that elevate the voices of women and children in village level planning. Multiple states integrated their priorities into Gram Panchayat Development Plans, contributing to reduced vulnerability and more responsive service delivery. Building on the national advisories issued in 2023 to institutionalize Bal/Balika Sabhas and Mahila Sabhas, UNICEF further enhanced participation systems in 2025 through technology. RapidPro was mainstreamed to support real time engagement, communication, and feedback across Gram Panchayats, with strong government leadership driving ownership and pathways for scale. This has reinforced more accountable, community driven local governance.
